Applicants seek anticipatory bail in Criminal Case No.256 of 2024, State Vs. Dilip Pradhan and Others, arising out of FIR No.100 of 2017, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC, Police Station Kaliyar, District Haridwar, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate-II, Roorkee, District Haridwar.

entities.text: State Vs. Dilip Pradhan and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
According to the FIR, while granting loan, rules were violated and irregularities committed.
It is argued by learned counsel for the applicants that during investigation, the arrest of the applicants was stayed by the court; now chargesheet has been filed.

Having considered the submissions, as an ad interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicants shall be released on bail subject to their furnishing personal bonds with two sureties, each in the like amount, by each one of them, to the satisfaction of the court concerned

In addition to it, the applicants shall also comply with the following conditions:-
(i) They shall not approach any witness in any manner, whatsoever.
(ii) They shall not leave the country without prior permission of the court concerned.

ABA/57/2025 on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181004134/

(iii) They shall deposit their passports with the court concerned.
The passports may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
In case, the applicants do not have passport, they shall give an undertaking to that effect to the court concerned.
(iv) The applicants shall also give an undertaking on (i) & (ii) above.

(Ravindra Maithani J.) 10.01.2025 RV ABA/57/2025 on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181004134/
